newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Activity light after hours.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Activity light after hours.

text.p: Stock trading was light after hours Friday, traders said.
"There's really nothing going on right now," said one trader.
The New York Stock Exchange said that no issues were unavailable for after hours trade for news.
The NYSE said that session one volume was 35,600 shares, compared to 112,100 shares Thursday. Session two volume was 83,700 shares versus 313,300 shares.
The American Stock Exchange said there was no after-hours activity.
